docs/tasks.full.yaml.text:
openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: tasks
  version: "1"
  summary: A small tasks api.
  description: |
    Tasks, read from a side file.
paths:
  /v1/admin/purge:
    post:
      operationId: purge
      responses:
        "204":
          description: Success.
        "400":
          description: api.schema_invalid
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.schema_invalid"
        "500":
          description: api.internal
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.internal"
      security: []
  /v1/health:
    get:
      operationId: health
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Health"
        "400":
          description: api.schema_invalid
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.schema_invalid"
        "500":
          description: api.internal
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.internal"
      security: []
  /v1/tasks:
    get:
      operationId: listTasks
      parameters:
        - name: cursor
          in: query
          required: false
          style: form
          explode: true
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: limit
          in: query
          required: false
          style: form
          explode: true
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 50
            default: 50
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success.
          headers:
            Link:
              schema:
                type: string
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task"
        "400":
          description: api.schema_invalid
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.schema_invalid"
        "500":
          description: api.internal
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.internal"
      security: []
  /v1/tasks/{taskId}:
    get:
      operationId: getTask
      parameters:
        - name: taskId
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        "200":
          description: Success.
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/Task"
        "400":
          description: api.schema_invalid
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.schema_invalid"
        "404":
          description: api.not_found
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.not_found"
        "500":
          description: api.internal
          content:
            application/problem+json:
              schema:
                $ref: "#/components/schemas/api.internal"
      security: []
components:
  schemas:
    ApiSchemaInvalidIssue:
      type: object
      properties:
        in:
          type: string
          pattern: ^(?:path|query|header|body)$
        pointer:
          type: string
        rule:
          type: string
      required:
        - in
        - pointer
        - rule
    ApiSchemaInvalidParams:
      type: object
      properties:
        issues:
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiSchemaInvalidIssue"
      required:
        - issues
    Health:
      type: object
      properties:
        status:
          type: string
      required:
        - status
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        taskId:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 100
      required:
        - taskId
        - title
    api.internal:
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          const: api.internal
        status:
          type: integer
          const: 500
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
        code:
          type: string
          const: api.internal
        nature:
          type: string
        traceId:
          type: string
      required:
        - type
        - status
        - code
        - nature
    api.not_found:
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          type: string
          const: api.not_found
        status:
          type: integer
          const: 404
        detail:
          type: string
        instance:
          type: string
        code:
          type: string
          const: api.not_found
        nature:
          type: string
        traceId:
          type: string
      required:
        - type
        - status
        - code
        - nature
    api.schema_invalid:
      allOf:
        - type: object
          properties:
            type:
              type: string
              const: api.schema_invalid
            status:
              type: integer
              const: 400
            detail:
              type: string
            instance:
              type: string
            code:
              type: string
              const: api.schema_invalid
            nature:
              type: string
            traceId:
              type: string
          required:
            - type
            - status
            - code
            - nature
        - $ref: "#/components/schemas/ApiSchemaInvalidParams"
